readout_other: TMS-evoked MEP amplitude in left FDI; F/M amplitude ratio and F-wave persistence (ulnar nerve); simple reaction-time pinch task
direction_notes: MEP amplitudes decreased immediately and 15 min after 16.0 mW/cm2 and 15 min after 8.0 mW/cm2 TUS; F-wave measures and reaction time (after sonication) were unchanged.
safety_notes: No severe adverse events; mild or moderate symptoms were reported by questionnaire. Scalp skin temperature in five adults did not change significantly.

exposures.label: Unfocused 30 kHz continuous TUS over right M1

timing.protocol_description: Continuous, unfocused sonication at 30 kHz: 300 ms sonications every 3 s (inter-stimulation interval) for a total of 20 min, at two intensities (16.0 and 8.0 mW/cm2 free-field Isp) plus sham.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Seventeen volunteers (9 females, average age ± standard deviation $2 3 \pm 2 { \bf y } )$ participated in the following three interventions, with varying intensities: spatial peak intensity (Isp) of 16.0 mW/cm² TUS (maximal output of the equipment), 8.0 mW/cm² TUS, and sham TUS for 20 min, at least 3 d apart.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: Moreover, the k-Wave simulation results indicated that the Isppa at M1 was 3.18 mW/cm² for the 8.0 mW/cm² input; given the use of continuous-wave ultrasound, the Ispta is equal to the Isppa.

flags.reason: Paper reports spatial peak intensity 'Isp' of 16.0 and 8.0 mW/cm2 (free-field), not Isppa by name; recorded in the Isppa field and converted to W/cm2. For continuous wave Isppa and Ispta coincide, but Ispta is left not_reported because the paper states this only for the simulated 8.0 mW/cm2 case.
k-Wave simulated at M1: Isppa 6.35 and 3.18 mW/cm2 (paper also gives simulated Isp 12.97 and 6.49 mW/cm2). The paper itself notes Isppa is lower than Isp, which is unusual for continuous wave.
Continuous, unfocused sonication of 300 ms repeated every 3 s for 20 min; recorded as continuous with the 300 ms burst as the sonication duration.
DC 100% stated in the same sentence as the 30 kHz and 300 ms parameters.
Sham played a masking sound through earphones; participants wore earphones during TUS too, but whether the masking sound was also played during active TUS is not stated.
Ultra-ma by World Brain (Tokyo); not a listed manufacturer so other_manufacturer.
